responsibility: This is the main code generator for executable target attribute evaluation and scheduling tables: it reads insn, attribute, delay-slot, bypass, and reservation definitions from the .md files, builds internal attr_desc and insn_def representations, expands synthetic attributes such as delay and length, optimizes attribute expressions, and writes the C/C++ implementations of get_attr_* routines plus DFA and latency support files. In contrast to genattr.cc, which declares interfaces, genattrtab.cc owns the full lowering of attribute expressions, alternative handling, and generated decision logic for instruction attributes and scheduling metadata.
